text: Hai Phong reserves 466ha of industrial land for high-tech and start-up businesses

Authorities of the northern port city of Hai Phong will reserve 465.89 hectares of industrial land for high-tech enterprises, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and innovative start-ups in the city's industrial parks, according to the Hai Phong Economic Zone Authority.

According to the authority's land portfolio, industrial parks established or implemented after the National Assembly's Resolution No. 198/2025/QH15 took effect on May 17, 2025, cover a total area of more than 3,559 hectares.
Of this, over 2,453 hectares are designated for industrial use, with 262.28 hectares allocated to high-tech firms, SMEs and innovative start-ups, equivalent to 10.7% of the industrial land.
Meanwhile, industrial parks established before May 17, 2025, have a combined area of 5,546.05 hectares, including 3,829.62 hectares of industrial land.
Of this, 203.61 hectares, or 5.3%, are reserved for the three groups of businesses.

The Hai Phong Economic Zone Authority said the review and public disclosure of available land aim to make it easier for businesses, particularly SMEs, high-tech enterprises and innovative start-ups, to access premises for production and business activities.
